issues.description: Renaming audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a breaking API change
issues.detail: The changelog notes a rename from audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size, but the diff only adds the new field. If the old field existed publicly, removing it without a deprecation alias will break existing user configurations silently (Pydantic would either reject the old key or ignore it depending on model config). Add a deprecated alias.

issues.description: Real-time pacing claimed but not implemented for fixed-size packets
issues.detail: The PR description and changelog promise 'real-time pacing' for endpoints like Vonage. The implementation only chunks payloads and sends them in a tight while-loop with no sleep/pacing based on _send_interval or _next_send_time. Vonage Audio Connector requires real-time delivery; bursty sends may overrun the receiver. Pacing logic is missing.

issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size buffer applied to all payloads, not just audio
issues.detail: The packetization branch triggers whenever payload is bytes/bytearray, regardless of whether the frame is audio. If the serializer ever emits binary control messages as bytes (or wav-headered audio), they will be sliced into fixed-size chunks and corrupted. Gate the buffering on isinstance(frame, AudioRawFrame) explicitly.

issues.description: VonageFrameSerializer ignores stereo and odd-sample-aligned audio
issues.detail: InputAudioRawFrame is hardcoded num_channels=1 with no validation that incoming bytes are even (16-bit aligned). If Vonage ever sends stereo (per content-type negotiation in websocket:connected, which is logged but unused), audio will be misinterpreted. Parse content-type from connect event to set channels/sample rate dynamically.

issues.description: Copyright header says 2024-2025 in a new 2026 file
issues.detail: The new serializer file uses a 2024-2025 copyright header, but today's date is 2026-05-30. Minor but worth aligning with repo convention for new files added this year.

issues.description: Final partial buffer never flushed on stream end
issues.detail: When the pipeline ends with a non-multiple-of-packet_bytes remainder in _audio_send_buffer, the trailing audio is silently dropped. Consider zero-padding and flushing the tail on EndFrame/CancelFrame to avoid clipped utterance endings on Vonage.

review.summary: The PR adds a clean VonageFrameSerializer and a useful fixed-size packetization path in FastAPIWebsocketTransport, but a few issues need attention before merge. The rename from audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size lacks a backward-compat alias, "real-time pacing" is advertised but not actually implemented (no sleep between chunks), and the packetization branch over-broadly applies to any bytes payload rather than audio frames specifically. The Vonage serializer hardcodes mono and ignores the content-type from websocket:connected, which limits robustness. Minor: copyright year and trailing-buffer flush on stream end.
